patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..6027ef3 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -530,6 +530,7 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
                 state,
                 mechanical_evidence.rejection_reasons,
                 contract,
+                verification_calls_used=len(isolated.receipts),
             )
             return
 
@@ -677,7 +678,12 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
             raise RuntimeError(
                 f"completion evaluation reached an illegal phase: {completion.accept.phase.reasons}"
             )
-        self._reject_completion(state, evidence.rejection_reasons, contract)
+        self._reject_completion(
+            state,
+            evidence.rejection_reasons,
+            contract,
+            verification_calls_used=len(isolated.receipts),
+        )
 
     async def _run_completion_check(
         self,
@@ -814,6 +820,8 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
         state: RunState,
         reasons: tuple[str, ...],
         contract: CompletionContract,
+        *,
+        verification_calls_used: int = 0,
     ) -> None:
         budget = contract.b_req
         state.completion_findings = _stable_unique(reasons)
@@ -825,6 +833,9 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
         repair_granted = not review_exhausted and repair_count_before < budget.max_repairs
         if repair_granted:
             state.repair_count += 1
+            state.environment_call_count = max(
+                0, state.environment_call_count - verification_calls_used
+            )
             state.phase = RunPhase.REPAIRING
         self._journal.append(
             "repair_admission",
@@ -902,10 +913,15 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
         if not state.finalization_started:
             return tuple(ActionKind)
         turns_remaining = self._options.max_turns - state.turn_count
+        remaining_calls = max(
+            0, self._options.max_environment_calls - state.environment_call_count
+        )
+        available_for_work = remaining_calls - self._options.verification_environment_reserve
         may_repair = (
             bool(state.completion_findings)
             and not state.finalization_repair_used
             and turns_remaining >= 2
+            and available_for_work > 0
         )
         if may_repair:
             return (ActionKind.EXECUTE, ActionKind.FINISH, ActionKind.STOP)
